1.why: ChainMixerMaster.cpp:277-281 writes one value with setVoltage and never calls setChannels

comment: The right-hand collection loop at ChainMixerMaster.cpp:207-219 advances with a dynamic_cast to ChainMixerChannelModule, so any Aux module to the right ends the walk and Channel modules past it are never mixed. The maker's manual does not mention this, and does not say channels may go on the right at all.
